title: Obtain interim advice without establishing lifecycle approval
goal: Obtain useful independent feedback on selected work without creating an implementation approval gate.
context: Implementation is in progress and the engineer explicitly requests advice on a bounded subject.
trigger: The engineer supplies the advisory review scope.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Identifies the inspected scope and requests advisory feedback.
Examines that scope and records attributable findings or a bounded clean conclusion.
Reports the advisory scope and any responsible correction without establishing whole-change approval.

expected_outcome: Useful findings are captured once and their limits are clear; interim advice does not become a mandatory milestone dossier.

alternatives.condition: The advisory assessment finds no concerns.
alternatives.outcome: The result remains advisory and does not permit final Verify to claim governed success.

failures.condition: A serious defect or unsafe action is identified.
failures.outcome: The finding triggers responsible correction or stopping affected unsafe work; advisory status does not make the evidence ignorable.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.
